column1: # install-legacy.tsv — every file an earlier Contextium release installed into a place
# v8 no longer writes, as <installed path>TAB<cksum CRC> <byte count>. install.sh
# removes such a file only while it still matches, so an edited one is the
# user's and stays. Made from the v6.0.0 and v7.0.0 tags:
#   its installed path and summed with `git show <tag>:<file> | cksum`.
# Plus each top-level entry of templates/agents/{skills,generators} at those tags
# that v8 does not install (a folder or file it no longer ships, or a test).
